headline: Marico Reports Record Q2 Profit Growth and Raises EBITDA Guidance
summary: Marico posted record profit growth for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 and raised its EBITDA guidance.
why: Marico is a major consumer goods company whose quarterly performance indicates broader consumer demand trends.

impacts.name: Marico Ltd
impacts.why: Record profit growth and raised guidance typically boost investor confidence and equity value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong earnings results and an upbeat outlook directly incentivize positive market valuation adjustments.
